ITEM.PTXT: The roof headlining is a molded ceiling with a knit surface material. In addition, the room light is mounted flush, giving an excellent appearance.
Rotating retractable assist grips (with damper) are provided on the roof sides. For convenience, the assist grips on both sides of the second seat have coat hooks.

The sun visors have ticket holders on the front surface on the driver and front passenger sides and large slide cover type vanity mirrors on the back surface. In addition, the vanity lights are located in the roof headlining for excellent usability.
A storage compartment that can hold 2 pair of sunglasses is provided in the overhead console, offering excellent usability and storage.
Large ceiling illumination is provided on the roof of G grade models.
